From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud procurement path & marketplace eligibility - Redwood

Hi Sara —

Great to speak earlier today — thanks for walking me through your use case and the team’s timeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement can decide the path:

Recap:
- Use case: GenAI document summarization across internal support docs (~2B tokens/month expected by Q4).
- Desired SLA/requirements: enterprise contract, SOC 2 Type II, monthly invoicing, possibility of data residency controls.
- Timeline: procurement evaluation this month; purchase target by end of May / early June.

Procurement paths we discussed:
1) AWS Marketplace (preferred if possible) — offers transactable SaaS subscription or Private Offer (PO via marketplace) which can streamline finance/IT approvals.
2) Direct PO to Redwood (net 30 or net 45) — standard enterprise route if marketplace setup is a blocker.
3) Credit card (temp) — only for pilot, typically not for annual commitments.

Questions / asks for procurement team:
- Will AcmeCloud accept an AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO) or require a vendor-sided invoice/PO route?
- Do you have a preferred PO template or special invoicing fields we need to populate? If so, can you share (I attached a generic PO_template.docx).
- Any legal checklist items beyond SOC 2 and standard DPA (e.g., export controls, on-prem requirement)?

What I can do from Redwood side:
- Introduce our Marketplace onboarding specialist to your procurement team to outline the AWS/GCP listing and Private Offer process (timeline ~2-4 weeks once we have account info).
- Share SOC 2 summary + compliance packet (attached).
- Provide a draft SOW / commercial terms for review or accept a PO directly once commercial terms are agreed.

Next steps
- Can you confirm whether marketplace (AWS) is preferred/acceptable to procurement?
- If marketplace, who on your side handles vendor registration (name/email)?
- If direct PO, can procurement share the PO template or required fields?

I’m available to hop on a short call with your procurement + legal (and our marketplace onboarding lead) this week or next — what works best?

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

- AcmeCloud_Marketplace_QA.pdf (high level: marketplace vs direct PO)
- PO_template.docx (placeholder you can replace with your template)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Ben Lowe <ben.lowe@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement path & marketplace eligibility - Redwood

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the summary — very helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side:

- AcmeCloud preference: AWS Marketplace Private Offer would be ideal since it ties into our finance system. If Redwood can support a Private Offer, procurement will generally accept that route.
- Vendor registration: we’ll need Redwood to register as a marketplace seller (we can share the vendor onboarding specialist contact once you confirm).
- PO / invoicing: for direct purchases we use a net 30 PO. Our AP team requires the following invoice fields: company tax ID, remit-to address, and a PO number. I’ll attach our standard PO template in a follow-up if you need it.
- Timeline: procurement is aiming to lock vendor by 05/28 to meet project start in early June.

Couple of legal questions (looping Ben):
- Do you provide SOC 2 Type II report and a DPA?
- Any data residency options (we need logs to remain in US regions)?

I’ve CC’d Ben (legal) who will look at contract terms/SLAs.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | AcmeCloud
+sara.patel@acmecloud.com

Subject: Re: AcmeCloud procurement path & marketplace eligibility - Redwood

Thanks Sara — that all makes sense and aligns with what we typically see. Quick answers and a suggested plan: 

Answers:
- Marketplace Private Offer: yes, we support AWS Marketplace Private Offers and can work with your procurement to complete vendor onboarding.
- SOC 2 / DPA: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA; I attached a SOC2 summary and our compliance packet. Full report can be shared under NDA if needed.
- Data residency: we support region controls for hosted accounts; we can ensure logs and inference compute remain in US regions for this contract.

Suggested plan (to hit your 05/28 timeline):
1) I’ll introduce your procurement contact to our Marketplace onboarding specialist today (quick kickoff to agree registration steps).
2) If procurement wants, we prepare a Private Offer quote and have it routed to your AP team (this typically satisfies the PO flow).
3) If marketplace timing looks tight, we’ll accept a direct PO (net 30) and then migrate to Marketplace for renewal if desired.

Can you:
- Share the procurement contact / vendor registration email for marketplace sign-up?
- Confirm whether the PO template you mentioned will include special remit fields (I can pre-populate on our side).

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min call Thurs 5/14 or Mon 5/18 with you, Ben, our marketplace specialist, and Jonas (SE) to walk through the private-offer steps and legal checklist.

Thanks,
Camila

Ben / Sara —

Thanks — looping in answers and attachments.

- SOC 2: attached "Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf" (full report available under NDA).
- DPA: we have a standard DPA; happy to share and track any redlines.
- Subprocessors: short list is included in the compliance packet (AWS for infra, S3 for storage, Datadog for monitoring). We note all subprocessors and controls in the packet.
- Marketplace vs Direct: Private Offer on AWS will likely be the fastest procurement path for AcmeCloud (fewer contract redlines + AP-friendly). If you prefer, we can accept a direct PO now and migrate later to Marketplace for renewal.

Proposed next steps to keep to your 05/28 target:
1) I’ll introduce your vendor onboarding contact to our marketplace specialist this morning (please reply with the vendor contact email if you haven’t already).
2) Schedule legal + procurement call: Mon 5/18 10–11am ET (Ben confirmed availability) — I’ll send calendar invite and include Jonas (SE) for tech questions.
3) I’ll prepare a Private Offer quote and draft terms to share with Ben ahead of the call.

Let me know the vendor onboarding contact and I’ll make the intro.

Best,
Camila
